name: Asherah
title: Waltz of Starlight
description: A noble young lady who joined the Journey to become a Savior like the Star Savior she admires. Her strong drive to act first rather than worry is both her strength and her weakness.
introduction:
A girl who has loved the legend of the Star Savior since childhood and dreamed of becoming an officially registered Savior with NOA. From formal historical records to absurd books of rumors, she obsessively collects anything related to the Star Savior.

Her tendency to act before thinking is both her strength and her weakness, often causing trouble for herself down the line.
Living on her own for the first time, she struggles with basic housekeeping and even general social common sense.

Asherah is more sincere than anyone about joining the Journey to inherit the Star Savior's power, having yearned for it since she was just a young girl. Though she always strives to do her best, her impatience can sometimes get the better of her.
